lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Nobody is unhappy. Nobody on this board is allowed the chance.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A garden where every flower blooms at once. No weeds. No bees.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: My mother's tulsi died every summer, and every summer she bought another. Nothing here is allowed to die.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One leaf near the rail has turned yellow. Nobody has corrected it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A screen scrolls eleven thousand Arjuns: school, marriage, a flood, no flood. In every one, he builds a warning system and it works.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: They all got what I wanted. Why am I the one that doesn't fit?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One row blinks red: THIS ONE. UNPREDICTED. OBSERVE.

lines.speaker: niyati
lines.text: Door four is to your left. Please come again, Doctor. I will be here, and so will you.

lines.speaker: niyati
lines.text: Door four, as before. Be well, Doctor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The fifth door opens on white light. A laboratory so clean his footsteps sound dirty.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: No flesh. No sand. Straight lines. This is the first place that feels built.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Behind glass three floors high, the blue whale hangs in her tank, one eye closed, wired with a thousand quiet cables.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: That's the anomaly. What I was sent to look at. It was never outside. It was always this.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She is longer than the lab is wide. Cables thick as his wrist run from her skull into a wall of dark servers.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: SUBJECT W-1. NEURAL CHANNEL: OPEN. STATUS: SEDATED, DREAMING.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: She's dreaming us. Or we are dreaming through her. I can't tell which is worse.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The closed eye moves, once, under its lid. The doors seem to breathe in the walls.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A monitor shows a man in a flooded cabin. Then a corridor of doors. Then the same man, walking into them.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: SUBJECT RAO, A. ROUTE LOG.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: ENTRY ORDER: {{roomOrder}}.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: ROOM 1: subject {{choiceLog:room1}}.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: ROOM 2: subject {{choiceLog:room2}}.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: ROOM 3: subject {{choiceLog:room3}}.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: ROOM 4: subject {{choiceLog:room4}}.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Every step. Every choice. They wrote it down like weather.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A second monitor shows other men in other cabins. Same face. Same wound at the hairline.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: RUN 1. SUBJECT RAO, A. NEVER FOUND THE SUBMARINE. DID NOT LEAVE THE HUB.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: RUN 4. SUBJECT FOUND THE SUBMARINE. DID NOT RETURN. SIGNAL LOST AT THE SURFACE.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: RUN 6. SUBJECT EMERGED FROM THE WHALE IN THE MEMORY PLAGUE. WITNESSES: 14. ONE RETAINED THE MEMORY: ILA.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Ila. She didn't dream me. She saw one of us, hundreds of years ago. I'm not the first.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: SELECTION NOTE, H. SATO: Subject must be unaware. Consent would contaminate the result.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Unaware. The accident was never an accident.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: SUBMARINE R-1: DOCKED. NOT LOST. BAY HIDDEN. ACCESS: ROOM 5.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: ROOM 5: NOT IN SOURCE. NOT IN BUILD. NOT IN SEED. ORIGIN: UNKNOWN.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Nobody programmed this room. It grew. If it isn't theirs, then whose is it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Figures in grey coats stand at consoles on the far side of the tank. None look up.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Hello! I can see you!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One of them rubs his eyes and reaches for tea. He does not hear. They watch a screen of me and never look at me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the intercom console, three small lights are waiting to turn green.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: INTERCOM OPEN. SUBJECT TO OPERATOR.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Arjun. You should not be able to see me. Never mind. Tell me what you decide, and I will hear it.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: I saw the route. I saw the others. I saw what you did to them.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Then say what we do with it.

choices.text: Use what I learned. Intervene in the future.
Shut KALPA down before it causes what it fears.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Then we use it. You will not like how.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: I haven't liked a thing since the cabin.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Behind the last monitor, a panel slides open on warm lamplight.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: That is the one thing I will not promise. But I heard you.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Then hear this too. It was your observation that made the rooms.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Behind the last monitor, a panel slides open on warm lamplight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Beyond the hatch: the smell of the sea, and lamplight on a curved steel hull.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Don't tell me. It was never lost.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A dry dock the size of a chapel. His submarine rests on its cradle, lamps dark, paint unscratched.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: No dents. No flood marks. It never sank. It was set down here like a coat on a hook.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The hatch is unlatched. Inside, the cabin is dry. The air smells of cold metal and nothing else.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: The burst pipes. Look at the seams. Cut clean, from the outside. Someone ran a blade along them.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Burst. Cut. They don't look anything alike.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: DIVE LOG, R. ARJUN: Anomaly near facility. Cleared to dock afterwards.

lines.speaker: log
lines.text: In other ink, below: 'Subject on schedule. Malfunction in four minutes. Retrieval team standing by.'

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Four minutes. They planned the minute I would lose the sky.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the rear of the bay, the floor opens into a flooded bore wide enough for a hull. The whale's passage.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Up through the belly, then out. Four rooms, one cabin, eleven minutes. Let me go home.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Light. Cold air. He breaks the surface of the moon pool and coughs up salt that may or may not be real.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hands lift him onto the deck. A ring of grey coats. One face he knows only from a signature.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The pool still ripples. Under the lamps a long dark shape passes below, and does not surface.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: She's still dreaming. Whatever I did, she hasn't woken up.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Your pulse is where we hoped. Don't stand yet. You have been unconscious for eleven minutes.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Eleven minutes. I lived three hundred years.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: You lived what the whale showed you. Eleven minutes of your life, and the machine read all of it.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: The pipes were cut. I saw the seams. You staged it.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Yes. A man who knows he is watched behaves like the average of men. We needed you.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Without asking.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Asking would have spoiled you. I will say I'm sorry once. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Shut KALPA down. All of it. Tonight.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: No. The machine found one future where people live. If I lose it, I may never find it again.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Don't launch blind. Use what I saw, and stop treating me as a variable.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: I will use all of it. But I will not stop the machine. It found one future where people live.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: It found it because you were watching. Watching changes what you see.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Then let us see what it looks like. Look at the monitor.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Look at the monitor, Arjun. Please.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The wall monitor wakes. White letters on black, the colour of an operating theatre.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: KALPA CLIMATE INTERVENTION — LAUNCH AUTHORISED IN: 11 DAYS

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Eleven days. The darkness isn't eleven days away. The decision is.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: {{readoutLabel}}: {{readoutFrom}}% → {{readoutTo}}%

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: The dry sea. Every look made it likelier. The looking is the weight.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: The forgetting. The more I watched, the more likely. Watching is a kind of pressure.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: The dark city, higher every time I looked. It was never meant to be looked at.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: The quiet world, climbing the more it's observed. NIYATI would call that a compliment.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Everything falls. All four. The more I let people be, the less any of them wants to happen.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: VARIABLE SUBJECT DETECTED: DR. ARJUN RAO. FUTURE OUTCOME: UNKNOWN.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The screen goes black.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: The sea first, then. A dry world is the easiest to see coming. We act now, and we act with you.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: A dry sea at the head of my list, and you want me to switch it off. Careful. You may be right.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Memory first, then. We cannot steer what we can no longer remember. Stay, and tell me what Ila said.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Forgetting is the cheapest future to prevent, and you want me to forget KALPA instead. I will think about it.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Light is the one thing we can build. We will keep the sky open, and you will tell us how.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: You walked out of the dark and now ask me to put out the lamp. I do not think I can.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: The quiet world is the one I want least. Use me as you will, but let me keep choosing.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: You saw what certainty becomes. Fine. Then ask me to doubt, and I will keep the machine off for one night.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Nothing rises. I have never seen that. We will intervene, carefully, with a machine that has nothing to predict.

lines.speaker: sato
lines.text: Nothing rises. A future no one is steering. I do not know how to run a project on that. Perhaps it is time.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: The dry sea is what we do when we steer without asking. If we steer, we ask the water first.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: I kept my water for the road and the sea left anyway. Switch it off. Let the rain decide.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: I met a woman who remembered me. If we change the world, we change who gets to remember it.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Some comfort is a quiet theft. Let KALPA go, and let people keep their own mornings.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: The lamps were kind and the dark was patient. If we reach for the sky, we do it with the lights on.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: I took the file and left the city its lamps. Turn the machine off before the sun learns to hide.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: NIYATI wanted to be right about me. If we intervene, we leave room to be wrong.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: A world that never chooses is a world that has already been chosen for. Shut it down. Let us be uncertain.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Every future fell because I let people choose. Maybe that is the only intervention that works.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: Every future fell. I gave people their choices back, and nothing rose. Shut it down. Let that be enough.

lines.speaker: arjun
lines.text: It never showed me what will happen. It showed me what we are making. None of it was inevitable.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the tank, the blue whale opens her eye.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On the lab monitor, a new door draws itself in light, though the machine is switched off.

ending.countdown: KALPA CLIMATE INTERVENTION — LAUNCH AUTHORISED IN: 11 DAYS
